The '''Edgeville Dungeon mine''' is a [[mines and mining sites|mine]] near the centre of the [[Edgeville Dungeon]]. The mine itself is north of the [[hill giant]]s and the ladder near the [[brass key]]. It is south of [[Vannaka]] and the [[Agility shortcut]] to [[Varrock Sewers]]. It is sometimes called the '''Skeleton Mine''' by some; similar to how several other mines guarded by skeletons are called the same, such as the [[Southern Wilderness mine]]. Due to being so far out of the way, the mine is almost never used by non-[[Free-to-play]] players.

It is a compact mine with a variety of [[ore]]s. The resident skeletons and the occasionally visiting [[hobgoblin]] may be dangerous for players with low [[combat level]]s.

==Transportation==
* The long way: From the dungeon entrance at [[Edgeville]], through the dungeon.
* The short way: In a small room north of the [[hill giant]]s but south of the mine, there is the [[brass key]] spawn. This key can be used to enter and exit the [[Edgeville Dungeon]] via the ladder just north of the hill giants. This is by far the fastest walking route to and from the mine.
* Nearest [[bank]]: [[Varrock west bank]], with the brass key. However, if a player has [[Varrock armour 3]], from completing their hard [[Varrock Diary]], they can use the bank within the [[Cooks' Guild]]. This bank is closer than [[Varrock west bank]].
* Teleportation: [[Paddewwa Teleport]], from the [[Ancient Magicks]] [[spellbook]], teleports the user to the entrance of Edgeville Dungeon. However, this is not recommended for long-term mining due to the distance to the mine from the teleport.
